kv22.8:1.3: Citte mahāpaṭhavī saṇṭhāti, mahāsamuddo saṇṭhāti, Sineru pabbatarājā saṇṭhāti, āpo saṇṭhāti, tejo saṇṭhāti, vāyo saṇṭhāti, tiṇakaṭṭhavanappatiyo saṇṭhantīti?
kv22.8:2.8: "Ajjhattikañ c' eva āvuso cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, n' eva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāvassa pātubhāvo hoti;
kv22.8:2.9: ajjhattikañ c' eva āvuso cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, n' eva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāvassa pātubhāvo hoti;
kv22.8:2.10: yato ca kho āvuso ajjhattikañ c' eva cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, tajjo ca samannāhāro hoti, evaṃ tajjassa viññāṇabhāvassa pātubhāvo hotīti."
kv22.8:3.9: "Ajjhattiko c' eva āvuso kāyo aparibhinno hoti bāhirā ca phoṭṭhabbā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti no ca --pe--
kv22.8:3.10: ajjhattiko c' eva āvuso kāyo aparibhinno hoti bāhirā ca phoṭṭhabbā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti no ca --pe--
kv22.8:3.11: yato ca kho āvuso ajjhattiko c' eva kāyo aparibhinno hoti bāhirā ca rūpā phoṭṭhabbā āpāthaṃ āgacchanti tajjo ca samannāhāro hoti, evaṃ tajjassa viññāṇabhāvassa pātubhāvo hotīti."
kv22.8:4.4: Sabbe dhammā niccā dhuvā sassatā avipariṇāmadhammā ti?
kv22.8:4.6: Tena hi ekacittakkhaṇikā sabbe dhammā ti.
